name: iac-change-risk-previewer
description: For open infrastructure-as-code pull requests, reports AWS-side risk (resource deletes and replacements, security-group openings, IAM broadening, weakened data protections) read from the plan or template, complementing the native code review. Read-only. Recommends AWS MCP augmentation (AWS IaC MCP Server and AWS Documentation MCP Server) used alongside the connected associations and AWS reads.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on THU at 07:00 UTC
